description: This file defines the IDGeneratorService class responsible for generating and managing unique identifiers for various entities within the OrangeHRM system, such as Location, JobCategory, JobTitle, Membership, and Employee. It provides methods to retrieve the next ID, update the ID counters, and generate prefixed IDs based on entity type.

classes.name: IDGeneratorService
classes.description: Service class responsible for generating sequential IDs with specific prefixes for various entities and managing ID counters within the system.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorDao
methods.description: Retrieves the IDGeneratorDao instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getEntityPrefix
methods.description: Returns a prefix string based on the entity class, used in ID generation.

methods.name: getNextID
methods.description: Generates the next ID with appropriate prefix and zero-padding based on entity type, optionally updating the database counter.

methods.name: incrementId
methods.description: Increments the current ID counter for a given entity class.
